# MiRust

MiRust.com is the public root-discovery and governance-orientation surface for
the Rust-oriented project family. It is not an implementation host, model
host, inference service, release proxy, or source-code authority.

Current root-discovery release: 2.6.0, dated 2026-08-29.

Verified public root files:
- https://mirust.com/
- https://mirust.com/llms.txt
- https://mirust.com/llms-full.txt
- https://mirust.com/robots.txt
- https://mirust.com/mirust-public-sitemap.xml
- https://mirust.com/.well-known/uaix-talisman.txt
- https://mirust.com/.well-known/ai-ready-route-inventory.json
- https://mirust.com/.well-known/mirust-site.json
- https://mirust.com/.well-known/site-release-history.json
- https://mirust.com/.well-known/site-release.json

Current public lanes:
- https://tinyrustlm.com/ - browser-local clean-slate SLM2 application shell, public release 0.3.0.
- https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/ - TinyRustLM developer documentation and bounded evidence portal, public release 1.8.1.
- https://minimodel.org/ - metadata-only SLM2 catalog and acquisition documentation, public release 1.1.1.
- https://minimodel.mirust.com/ - MiniModel developer documentation, public release 1.1.0.

Runtime.MiRust.com redirects to the TinyRustLM developer portal.
LMComposer.com and SLMComposer.com redirect to TinyRustLM.com. Redirect-only
names are not separate products, source authorities, runtimes, schemas, or
compatibility contracts.

Historical implementations and superseded metadata contracts exist only in
Git history. Current source and production paths contain no legacy reader,
validator, schema, fallback, compatibility alias, or migration.

No public root file proves a qualified model, real model execution, peer
availability, portable-memory round, deployment beyond its named release, or
campaign progress. Read visible files, cite canonical routes, respect robots
and terms, do not infer hidden authority, and no-op unsupported requests.
